_source: B2_RESULTS.md — 'Sensorlu GERCEK-DUNYA latency + enerji' section, measured 2026-07-10
_description: Sensor-in-the-loop end-to-end latency and system power on MSP430G2553. Real MPU6050 read over USCI_B0 I2C + one recurrent step, 50 Hz pacing, 512 samples per run. Firmware: msp/ccs_{cell}_har, TEST_MODE 4 (latency) / 5 (energy), -O3, USE_LUT selects table-based activations, I2C_FAST selects the bus clock.

_measurement.latency: measured in firmware with a 1 ms Timer_A tick, averaged over 512 consecutive samples
_measurement.power: measured with INA226 (R_sh = 0.1 ohm) on the target supply rail; the MPU6050 is powered from the same measured rail, so power is system power (MCU + I2C + sensor)
_measurement.split_caveat: When the sensor read costs less than the 1 ms tick (LUT + 100 kHz), the sensor/inference split phase-locks and is not resolvable; the end-to-end value is still reliable (14+ ticks). Runs where sensor_ms + inference_ms does not reconstruct e2e_ms are flagged split_resolved = false.

system_power_mw._note: Steady-state INA226 reading. Independent of cell and of LUT; depends only on the I2C bus clock (longer bus-active time at 10 kHz).
